versions.changelog:
Initial release of acpx-harness-routing skill.

- Establishes strict principles and step-by-step decision tree for all ACPX harness task routing.
- Defines clear one-line routing rules for different agent roles (Claude, Codex, Gemini) and task types (one-shot vs. continuous).
- Mandates explicit parameterization for all harness calls: always approve all, deny interactive inputs.
- Documents required session naming, working directory (`--cwd`), and session continuity rules.
- Provides ready-to-use execution templates and clearly lists verified capabilities and current limitations.
